method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the claimant), with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING where it does not answer); the dates in one module (the only one importing daydate), the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; two regulative rules (s 231(5) MUST on the regulator, s 273 SHANT on the business) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Health and Safety (National Uniform Legislation) Act 2011 (NT), Act No. 39 of 2011, reprint REPW025 as in force at 1 February 2020 (the current reprint on the NT Legislation register on 6 November 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Work-Health-and-Safety-National-Uniform-Legislation-Act-2011-NT-current-reprint-REPW025.txt. Penalties as stated in each section (dollars; industrial manslaughter by a body corporate in penalty units).

seat: the claimant: the worker hurt or put at risk at work, and their family (ss 35 to 37, 84, 88, 31 to 34B, 231 to 232, 34E); the worker, prospective worker or other person punished, pressured or misled for a safety reason (Part 6); the worker affected by an inspector's or the regulator's decision (Part 12); the person whose loss an inspector's powers caused (s 184); the worker with a contract term or a charge about safety (ss 267, 272, 273) (whsnt-claims.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run whsnt-dates.l4 ; l4 run whsnt-claims.l4 ; l4 run whsnt-cases.l4
checks.result: 175 assertions written, 175 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); two deliberately wrong assertions in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Claims. In: ss 35 to 37 (notifiable incident); ss 84, 88, 103 (ceasing unsafe work); the maximum penalties of ss 31, 32, 33, 34B, 104, 107, 108, 109; Part 6 whole (ss 104 to 115); ss 231(1) to (3), (5), (8), 231A(1), (4), 231B, 232, 34E; s 184; Part 12 ss 223 (items 1 to 12 with 4A, 4B), 224, 226, 228(1) to (5), 229(1) to (3), 229B(1), (2); s 267; s 272; s 273. Out: the Part 2 duties and offence elements, s 34, ss 34A, 34C, 34D, ss 38(2) to (7), 39, Part 4, Part 5 except ss 84, 88, 103, Parts 7, 8, 10, 11 (except as inputs), Part 9 except s 184, ss 225, 227, 228(6), 229A, 229C, 229D, s 230, s 231(4), (7), (9), s 231A(2), (3), s 233, Part 13 Divisions 2 to 7, ss 268 to 271, codes, regulation-making, Part 15, Schedules. Reasons in NOTES.md.
